text_block_list.text:
Woe is me... A tragic defeat! However,
setbacks
are the essence of a good
story. The mighty foe
will have their just
desserts at the next
engagement.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
I've realized this loss owes to my being a
merciful
king. The compassion I feel for
others is too
great. I repent this passivity
and look to seize my
generation's
throne.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Thus, I advance my pieces onward to the

Japanese Derby, a fitting venue to
further bolster
my name!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
